integrity: All source dates reflect earliest verified public preprints, not later revisions or journal dates. Proof is self-contained modulo the standard Hypercyclicity Criterion. Finite diagnostic checks are not an infinite-dimensional proof. The outcome has same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires radial nonzero vertex weights with a bounded one-step inverse ratio on the standard quadrant; it does not address nonradial or higher-dimensional lattices, or frequent hypercyclicity. All p=2 radial dynamical criteria and their asymptotic Hilbert singular-value exponents are credited to Chen--Wang--Zhou. A broader unlocated Banach finite-difference or lattice-dynamics theorem could affect publication priority.
title: Sharp non-Hilbert Pascal transfer exponents and radial lattice dynamics
